description.p: t-code is a native C and C++ editor with a project file tree, editor tabs, a terminal, and clangd language support. Work with Git changes, render Markdown previews, and build and debug programs from the editor.

ul.li: Complete code, navigate symbols, and apply clangd quick fixes
Review Git diffs and edit several files in split views
Run Make, CMake, and Meson builds with the included development tools

description.p: This package runs projects and terminal commands inside a sandbox. Open a project folder with the file chooser to grant access to its contents. Host-installed tools, libraries, credentials, and files outside the selected folder are not automatically available.

screenshot.caption: C and C++ editing with a project tree and terminal

description.p: Fixes update release URL launching from dialog and compile commands string escaping for clangd.
Plugins system, Problems panel, Tasks runner, Crash recovery, Flatpak, Snap, AUR support, and test suite improvements.
Adds a GDB debugger, code folding, quick fixes, and configurable themes.
